name: A New Beginning
source:
A story of alien invasion, magic, political intrigue and how a complete nobody might very well save the world. 

A small family becomes embroiled in a series of misadventures and mishaps when they come into possession of a ‘magic’ book. This leads to extraordinary events for the MC and all the women around him and to discoveries about the book and what it means to the whole world. Only one young man can control the outcome; the owner of the book.

[From [url=https://www.patreon.com/xyvisualnovels]Patreon[/url]]
translation:
这是一个关于外星入侵、魔法、政治阴谋，以及一个无名小卒如何可能拯救世界的故事。

一个小家庭得到了一本“魔法”书，由此卷入一连串意外与波折。主角及身边的女性经历了种种非同寻常的事件，也逐渐发现了这本书的秘密，以及它对整个世界的意义。只有一个年轻人能左右最终的结果——这本书的主人。

[摘自[url=https://www.patreon.com/xyvisualnovels]Patreon[/url]]
